title: AuthGroup is the type for a LXD group.

access_entitlements.description: AccessEntitlements represents the entitlements that are granted to the requesting user on the attached entity.

description.description: Description is a short description of the group.

identities.description: Identities is a map of authentication method to slice of identity identifiers.

identity_provider_groups.description:
IdentityProviderGroups are a list of groups from the IdP whose mapping
includes this group.

name.description: Name is the name of the group.

permissions.description: Permissions are a list of permissions.

entitlement.description: Entitlement is the entitlement define for the entity type.

entity_type.description: EntityType is the string representation of the entity type.

url.description: EntityReference is the URL of the entity that the permission applies to.

Permission.title: Permission represents a permission that may be granted to a group.
